    <p class="hero-desc">SSE-protected personal vault + true E2EE peer-to-peer file sharing. Two security models. One Flutter app.</p>
    <div class="callout">
      The server never sees your file. File transfers are client-to-client, encrypted end-to-end with AES-256-GCM chunks, RSA-4096 key wrapping, and Ed25519 signatures.
    </div>

  <!-- OVERVIEW -->
  <div class="section">
    <span class="section-anchor" id="overview"></span>
    <h2>1. Overview</h2>
    <p>SecureVault is a mobile application that combines two distinct security models into one experience.</p>
    <p><strong>Personal Cloud Vault (SSE)</strong> — Upload and store files encrypted server-side using AES-256-GCM with a DEK/KEK key wrapping model. Files are encrypted at rest; the server manages encryption keys.</p>
    <p><strong>SecureShare (E2EE)</strong> — Transfer files directly between devices over WebRTC DataChannel. Encryption keys are generated on-device, stored in SecureStorage, and never leave the client. The server acts as a WebSocket signaling relay only — it has zero knowledge of file content. Every 16KB chunk is AES-256-GCM encrypted, RSA-4096 key-wrapped, and Ed25519 signed. If signature verification fails on the receiver side, the file is destroyed immediately.</p>
    <p><strong>Security Dashboard</strong> — Real-time SIEM-style monitoring of login events, device registrations, file accesses, and suspicious activity. Async email alerts powered by Celery and Resend.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- FEATURES -->
  <div class="section">
    <span class="section-anchor" id="features"></span>
    <h2>2. Features</h2>
    <ul class="feature-list">
      <li>SSE vault with DEK/KEK key wrapping</li>
      <li>True E2EE file sharing over WebRTC</li>
      <li>RSA-4096 key exchange on sign-in</li>
      <li>Ed25519 file signing + SHA-256 integrity</li>
      <li>COTURN STUN/TURN NAT traversal fallback</li>
      <li>Identity verification — blocks unverified senders</li>
      <li>Tamper detection → file destroyed immediately</li>
      <li>Security dashboard with 7-day activity charts</li>
      <li>Threat level distribution (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH)</li>
      <li>Alert type breakdown by event category</li>
      <li>Active device management + session revoke</li>
      <li>Async email alerts via Celery + Resend</li>
      <li>Passcode-protected secure rooms</li>
      <li>Flutter BLoC clean architecture</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <!-- ARCHITECTURE -->
  <div class="section">
    <span class="section-anchor" id="architecture"></span>
    <h2>3. Architecture</h2>

    <h3>High-Level Design</h3>
    <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="SecureVault HLD" style="width:100%; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #ddd; background:#fff; padding:12px; margin: 12px 0 20px;"/>

    <p>The system is structured into five layers:</p>
    <ul style="padding-left:20px; color:#333; font-size:14px; line-height:2;">
      <li><strong>Client Sandbox (Flutter)</strong> — Presentation (AuthBloc / RoomBloc / FileTransferBloc), Domain (use cases & repositories), Data (remote + local sources)</li>
      <li><strong>Protocol Routing</strong> — Dynamic routing between WebSocket (signaling) and WebRTC (data transfer)</li>
      <li><strong>Core Services</strong> — Auth, Room, File Transfer, Threat Monitor running on DRF + Django Channels</li>
      <li><strong>Data Persistence</strong> — PostgreSQL for metadata, Redis (Upstash) for sessions/pub-sub, encrypted disk for vault ciphertext</li>
      <li><strong>Zero-Server P2P Plane</strong> — Direct UDP via WebRTC DataChannel. COTURN STUN/TURN relay fallback — only zero-knowledge ciphertext forwarded</li>
    </ul>

    <h3>E2EE File Sharing — How It Works</h3>
    <ol class="flow-steps">
      <li><strong>Key Generation (Sign-In)</strong> — Client generates 4096-bit RSA and Ed25519 keys. Private keys stored in device SecureStorage. Public keys registered with server.</li>
      <li><strong>P2P Handshake (WebSocket)</strong> — Both peers connect, fetch each other's public keys, exchange SDP offer/answer, and complete ICE candidate exchange in parallel. Signaling server is bypassed once WebRTC DataChannel opens.</li>
      <li><strong>Encrypted Streaming</strong> — AES session key generated, wrapped with receiver's RSA public key, file metadata signed with Ed25519 private key. Each 16KB chunk encrypted locally before transmission via WebRTC (direct UDP or COTURN relay).</li>
      <li><strong>Identity Verification (Receiver)</strong> — SHA-256 hash computed, Ed25519 signature verified using sender's public key. If authentic → save to Downloads. If tampered or identity not verified → file destroyed immediately, transfer blocked.</li>
    </ol>

    <div class="callout warning">
      <strong>Identity not verified:</strong> If Ed25519 signature verification fails, the transfer is blocked and the temporary file is destroyed. The receiver sees a critical alert as shown in the screenshots below.
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SECURITY MODEL -->
  <div class="section">
    <span class="section-anchor" id="security"></span>
    <h2>6. Security Model</h2>
    <p>SecureVault deliberately separates vault storage from file sharing — each with the right security model for its use case.</p>
    <div class="sec-compare">
      <div class="sec-card">
        <div class="sec-card-header vault">🗄️ Personal Vault (SSE)</div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Encryption</span><span class="val">AES-256-GCM server-side</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Key model</span><span class="val">DEK wrapped by server KEK</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Server role</span><span class="val">Manages keys + ciphertext</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Integrity</span><span class="val">GCM authentication tag</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Tamper response</span><span class="val">Log + HTTP 403</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sec-card">
        <div class="sec-card-header e2ee">📤 SecureShare (E2EE)</div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Encryption</span><span class="val">AES-256-GCM client-side</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Key model</span><span class="val">RSA-4096 wrapped, private key stays on device</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Server role</span><span class="val">Signaling relay only — zero file knowledge</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Integrity</span><span class="val">Ed25519 signature + SHA-256</span></div>
        <div class="sec-card-row"><span class="label">Tamper / unverified</span><span class="val">Destroy temp file immediately</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TECH STACK -->
  <div class="section">
    <span class="section-anchor" id="stack"></span>

<script>
  function showTab(id, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById('tab-' + id).classList.add('active');
    btn.classList.add('active');
  }
  function openLightbox(img) {
    document.getElementById('lightbox-img').src = img.src;
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
  }
  function closeLightbox() {
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open');
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox(); });
</script>
